payload.text: Before the 0.1.10 cut, on vc's word that the tip is final: the kovacs gates (check all, test all, build and doctor) and, in the same heavy slot, a scratch-HOME bin/devbin install with a listing of the opt tree and its manifest, showing LICENSE in the tree and named in the manifest (ISSUE:0009: no run has yet laid out an installed tree with the files entry back). The final tip is cc's follow-up unit (ISSUE:0008's items 6 to 8) on 58b7323, which holds the first. When vc says it is final, dc asks devbin-vc for the slot by intent estate slots ask, naming hv's decision 12; the estate hold is lifted (hv's decision 13), and devbin-vc grants Ccusage first today. dc announces the run to kovacs-sysadm. The cut carries ISSUE:0008 whole, ISSUE:0009 and ic's Herdr fix, and ships first thing (hv's decision 12, through vc).
